label: A_cP1_221_a-001
title: $\alpha$-Po ($A_{h}$, simple cubic) Structure
comments:
Solid polonium exists in two phases: cubic \href{current_web_home_dir/A_cP1_221_a-001}{$\alpha$-Po ($A_{h}$)} (this structure) is the ground state and rhombohedral \href{current_web_home_dir/A_hR1_166_a-001}{$\beta$-Po ($A_{l}$)} (Donohue, 1974). There is a large amount of hysteresis observed in the transition, which occurs at 54$^\circ$C for $\alpha \rightarrow \beta$ and 18$^\circ$ for $\beta \rightarrow \alpha$. 
 This is a simple cubic lattice. Polonium is the only element known with this ground state. Originally Po was assigned {\em Strukturbericht} designation \href{current_web_home_dir/A_mC12_5_3c-001}{$A19$}, which is now considered to be incorrect. (Donohue, 1982, 390)
